metadata.title: Berhampur Street Food Tour I Odisha Food Walks I Indian Street Food
metadata.description:
Berhampur is a foodie city of Odisha. We met two enthusiastic foodies in town- Vaishali and Jagdish from Discover Berhampur who helped us explore the street gems of Berhampur. 

Here we tried following dishes-

1. Pickles, Papad and Nabat- Bada Bazar
2.Balaji Sweets- Bada Bazar
Must try- Malpua, Rasbali, Kakara and Anto Pakudi
3. Hotel Girija- Girija Chhaka
Must try -Pudding
4. Pidha Hotel, City High School Road
Must try- Mutton Curry
5.New Briyani Centre- Corporation Road, Biju Patnaik Park
Must try- Mutton Biryani
6. Gopalpur Beach
Must try- Jhalmudi
7. Billu Dhaba- NH 16
Must try- Egg Tadka
8. Rahim KGN Kebab- Corporation Road, Biju Patnaik Park
Must try- Kebab
9. Mix Chakuli- City High School Road
Must try- Mix Vegetable Chakuli
10. Sprouts Chaat- City High School Road
Must try- Sprouts Chaat
11. Sri Ram Ghugni Chaat- City High School Road
Must try- Ghugni Chaat
12. Kishore Pakoda, Giri Market 
Must try- Saku, jackfruit chips, Papu segudiliu
13. Hotel Samala, Annapurna Market
Must try- Puri Upma

About Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
